title: BAA BAA BLACK SHEEP Children's Song with Lyrics
speaker: Twinkle Little Songs - Nursery Rhymes
zh: 【Twinkle Little Songs - Nursery Rhymes】咩咩黑羊兒歌（附歌詞）（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: ♫ Baa, black sheep, have you any wool? ♫
cues.en: ♫ Baa, black sheep, have you any wool? ♫
cues.zh: ♫ 咩，害群之馬，你有羊毛嗎？ ♫

cues.text: ♫ Yes, sir, yes, sir, three bags full ♫
cues.en: ♫ Yes, sir, yes, sir, three bags full ♫
cues.zh: ♫ 是的，先生，是的，先生，裝滿了三袋♫

cues.text: ♫ One for my master and one for my dame ♫
cues.en: ♫ One for my master and one for my dame ♫
cues.zh: ♫ 一份給我的主人，一份給我的女士 ♫

cues.text: ♫ And one for the little boy who lives down the lane ♫
cues.en: ♫ And one for the little boy who lives down the lane ♫
cues.zh: ♫ 一份是送給住在巷子那頭的小男孩 ♫
